transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Well, Dr. Smith, I'm here because... honestly, I’ve been trying for months now to get people to understand what's going on. My husband’s family is... they're quietly messing with our money and our good name. 

It's just, things keep happening. Like, I'll be at work—I do billing—and these little errors just keep showing up out of nowhere. Or I go to church and suddenly someone is acting funny toward me, like they've been told something behind my back. And no matter what records anyone pulls up to try and explain it away, I know it ties back to them. I just need someone to finally see what they're doing to us.
Have you experienced any periods where your mood felt unusually low or, conversely, periods where you felt unusually high, energetic, or irritable?

No, not really. I mean, I get frustrated, of course, because of everything that's going on with my husband's family. It's stressful trying to deal with all the little things they do to mess with us. But I haven't had any times where I'm just depressed for no reason, or where I'm bouncing off the walls with energy. My mood is pretty normal, just... tired of dealing with them, honestly.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that others could not perceive?

No, I haven't. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. I mean, the things I'm talking about—the errors at work, the way people look at me at church—those are real things happening right in front of me. I'm not imagining them. It's just that I'm the only one connecting the dots back to his family. But no, no voices or anything like that.
How long have you felt that your husband's family has been acting against you in these ways?

It's been going on for about nine months now. It all started back then, right around the time we had some... trouble with his family. There were disagreements over money, and then some arguments about holiday expectations and who was doing what. Ever since then, that's when all these things started happening.

If you were presented with clear, objective evidence that your husband's family was not involved in these workplace errors or the behavior of people at church, would you be willing to consider an alternative explanation?

Honestly... no. I mean, I hear what you're saying about evidence, but I’m here because for months now I’ve been trying to get people to understand that my husband’s family is quietly messing with our money and our good name. 

When those little billing errors show up at work, or someone at church suddenly acts funny toward me... I know what's causing it. No matter what records anyone pulls up to try and show me otherwise, I know it ties back to them. There just isn't another explanation that makes sense.
Have these concerns caused you to miss work, lose your job, or withdraw from your social relationships?

No, I haven't lost my job or missed work. I still go in and take care of all my usual responsibilities, both at work and at home. 

It has caused some friction, though. I mean, I've had a lot more arguments with my husband lately about it. And there have definitely been some awkward moments at church, mostly because people think I should just drop the whole thing and move on. But as far as my day-to-day life goes, no, I haven't withdrawn or stopped doing what I'm supposed to do.
